Table with column alignment attributes

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<table><thead><tr><th align=\"left\">Left</th><th align=\"center\">Center</th><th align=\"right\">Right</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>L</td><td>C</td><td>R</td></tr></tbody></table>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content())
```
